objective: Locate the first arithmetic stage responsible for the retained sample-16 one-LSB main-edge error by comparing a frozen local renderer with custom-Metal replays captured only after this registration.

preOpeningHarnessCorrection.fault: The first wrapper selected the final production specialization, which intentionally specializes NumericTrace to zero and therefore cannot emit diagnostic stages.
preOpeningHarnessCorrection.correction: Select the full executable-spec shader and explicitly apply the same recovered exact configuration used by the production specialization.

frozenInterpretation: A first divergence in sdf or sdf-coverage localizes the retained error to SDF construction, half conversion, fine derivatives, or coverage arithmetic.
Exact sdf and sdf-coverage followed by a color-stages-a divergence localizes it to source sampling or face construction.
Exact color-stages-a followed by color-stages-b localizes it to edge, bleed, shadow, or holding composition.
Exact color stages followed by final-color localizes it to clamp or EDR arithmetic.
All custom-Metal stages exact while the Apple BGRA8 prefix remains inexact localizes it after the compared shader stages, but does not prove the private Apple shader uses the same intermediates.

acceptance.verdict: diagnostic first-divergent-stage result; this is not a parity gate

limitations: These are custom-Metal reimplementation stages executed on the captured buffers and raster state, not private Apple fragment-shader intermediates.
The unmodified Apple private shader remains the endpoint BGRA8 oracle.
This probe covers only clear/light materialize sample 16.
No result from this probe authorizes a production shader change or a Liquid Glass parity claim.
